about: ASR benchmark test set. Audio is NOT in the repo; fetch_audio.py materialises it into $CACHE/audio/<id>.wav (16 kHz mono PCM16).

licences.librispeech-test-clean: LibriSpeech ASR corpus (OpenSLR SLR12), CC BY 4.0, derived from public-domain LibriVox audiobooks. Panayotov, Chen, Povey, Khudanpur, ICASSP 2015. Utterances picked by fetch_audio.py --pick 12 (one per speaker, 5-20 s).
licences.whisper.cpp-samples: jfk.wav shipped in whisper.cpp samples/ (MIT repo); audio is the JFK 1961 inaugural address, US government work, public domain.
